## Descriptive ESS-WID Association

The merged table uses the earliest matched observation in each two-year ESS
round and the corresponding WID distribution. It retains ESS reliability,
effective sample size, the selected post-tax income series where available,
and WID extrapolation flags. The full country-round table is available as
[data/processed/ess_wid_country_round.csv](data/processed/ess_wid_country_round.csv).

All summaries and correlations below use ESS observations flagged reliable.
Correlations are descriptive only; no significance tests are performed. The
Gini values are approximated from WID's ten decile shares. Negative net wealth
shares can produce wealth Gini values above one.

### Variance Decomposition

Between-country and within-country percentages describe where the reliable
country-round variation in each measure occurs.

```{r}
#| label: association-variance-decomposition
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(ess_wid_association$variance, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE)
```

### Between-Country Association

the mean ESS `stfeco` score with the corresponding decile-based WID Gini.
Each point is a country's mean across reliable ESS rounds. The two panels compare
the mean ESS `stfeco` score with the corresponding decile-based WID Gini. Only a
few points farthest from the center are labeled to keep the scatter readable.

```{r}
#| label: association-between-country
#| echo: false
knitr::include_graphics(ess_wid_association$plot_files[["between"]])
```

### Within-Country Association

Values are demeaned within each country, separating changes over time from
persistent differences between countries.

```{r}
#| label: association-within-country
#| echo: false
knitr::include_graphics(ess_wid_association$plot_files[["within"]])
```

### ESS Year Pattern

The line shows the reliable cross-country mean by year; the band spans the
cross-country 25th to 75th percentiles. Larger points indicate more reliable
country observations in that year.

```{r}
#| label: association-year-pattern
#| echo: false
knitr::include_graphics(ess_wid_association$plot_files[["year_patterns"]])
```

### Pearson Correlations

Pairwise-complete descriptive correlations among ESS mean/IQR and WID Gini and
selected group shares.

```{r}
#| label: association-pearson
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(ess_wid_association$pearson, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE)
```

### Spearman Correlations

Rank-based descriptive correlations using the same reliable observations.

```{r}
#| label: association-spearman
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(ess_wid_association$spearman, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE)
```
